import re

def parse_requirements(text):
    names = []
    for line in text.strip().splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        name = re.split(r'[=<>!~;\[ ]', line, maxsplit=1)[0].strip()
        if name:
            names.append(name)
    return names

req_txt = 'requests==2.31.0\nflask==3.0.0\npytest==7.4.0\n'
print(parse_requirements(req_txt))

pkgs = [line.split('==')[0].strip() for line in req_txt.strip().splitlines()]
assert pkgs == ['requests', 'flask', 'pytest']
